title: Compute-budget speedrun capstone

paper.title: MLPerf Training Benchmark
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Compute-budget speedrun capstone: combine an explicitly chosen model optimization and evaluation task into a reproducible fixed-compute speedrun; benchmark citation is methodological background not a canonical speedrun model paper. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use declared-capstone-task; required output: Documented task-specific torch module and reproducible timing harness. Evaluate task_quality (maximize). One task one split and fixed compute; report ablations speed memory and quality honestly. Required ablation: Disable each optimization separately and report quality throughput and memory deltas. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
